mentions.name: GolfRise
mentions.description: Mobile app for golfers that reads a photo of the post-round scorecard, automatically extracting and saving the scores and stats, with support for posting scores to the USGA for players who keep a handicap.
mentions.problem: Golfers who don't like using their phones while they play need a way to record scores and stats without handling the phone during the round.
mentions.audience: Golfers, including those who keep a USGA handicap
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a mobile app for golfers who don't like using their phones while they play. Take a picture of your scorecard after the round and it reads/saves the scores and stats (and allows you to post to the USGA if you keep your handicap).

evidence.value: I built a mobile app for golfers who don't like using their phones while they play. Take a picture of your scorecard after the round and it reads/saves the scores and stats (and allows you to post to the USGA if you keep your handicap).
